title: An Invitation to Come Home
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
King Hezekiah sent the word
Across the land so wide:
“Come back to God! Come celebrate!
Come, gather, side by side!”

[Chorus]
Heavenly Father calls to me,
“Come back, come close to Me,”
And when I come with humble heart,
How happy I will be!

[Verse 2]
Some laughed and said, “We will not go,”
But many, humble, came,
They sang and worshiped, full of joy,
And praised God’s holy name.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes; He calls you too,
So come to Him in prayer,
Then rest in joy; the Lord is near,
And He will meet you there.

[Chorus]
mood: Welcoming music. A bright, gentle skipping pulse moves under the voice like invitations travelling from town to town and glad feet answering, matching the joy of Hezekiah's celebration when hearts turned back to God. The chorus is warm and open-armed, the happiest part of the song each time it comes. By the last verse the skip settles into a slow, low sway, the celebration drifts off in the distance, and the song comes home to a soft, glad quiet.
